The final six-metric workflow uses fixed national supports, IDW p=2, temperature anomalies, rainfall climatology ratios, one study-specific rainfall calibration, and area weighting. HAC is primary; modified MK is the autocorrelation-adjusted non-parametric sensitivity. See `docs/SCIENTIFIC_METHODS_AND_REFERENCES.md`.

```{r}
library(SIECCLongWeather)
area_weighted_mean(c(10, 20), c(1, 3))
assign_djf(as.Date("2000-12-15"))
```
